_comment: A lone block of 48 Infantry (6 files of 8) in open order (loose, 36 wu pitch) facing west, doubled to 12 files of 4 by the half-file explicatio on the same ground (Asclepiodotus 10.17, Aelian 29.3): the line keeps its length and the block closes into compact order (normal, 18 wu pitch, Asclepiodotus 4.1). Asclepiodotus inserts the new files between the original files, so every original file keeps its place, file leader included, and each rear half-file comes up in the gap beside its own file. That needs every interval on one side; the script names no side, and on the same ground the sim reads the default (outward) as the spear side, its own choice: each rear half-file steps into the gap on its file's right (north). Every one of the 6 file leaders ends 0.00 wu across the front from where he stood (before this, read outward, each left-wing leader closed half an old pitch, 18 wu). The front rank keeps its line at x 554. The left (south) flank stands at y 610 and the right (north) flank gains half the old pitch, 18 wu (y 430 to 412): the one new file beyond the last original file, the sim's inference. So the block's position ends at (581.12, 511.0): forward of where it stood, since its depth halves and its ranks close. The nearest two men came 16.79 wu apart, at tick 276. The drill ends by tick 536. Measured 2026-11-13 on FULL 2-tick dumps from the order to tick 760, seed run 0; the drill plays out identically on seed runs 0 to 4 (no enemy, no roll). On main, which has no readings, the script's explicatio block is not read and B deals the default drill, so the position expect fails there. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd, whose explicatio block sets the readings the B key deals (tools/demo/DemoExplicatio.gd); world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
